setup: CREATE TABLE users (user_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, score DOUBLE)
INSERT INTO users SELECT i::BIGINT, (i % 7)::DOUBLE FROM range(100101) t(i)

expect.message: 100,001 entities is past the 100,000 one materialize() will hold at once, since every batch is built, with its own context, before any is sent; ask about fewer entities at a time

why: 100,001 entities, one past the 100,000 the reference's materialize() gathered: the reference refused it UNSUPPORTED_REQUEST from the count; this client sets no most and gathers it (contract/expected); user_id is declared the key, as the core and the reference read it either way, so the loader indexes it on SQLite and Postgres and a lookup there is not a scan of 100,101 rows
source: Correctness case multicall.entities.100001 using the shop fixture.
